title: HELIX Bridge: PeopleSoft Commitment Control / Budget → Budget

source_objects.description: Budget ledger: BUSINESS_UNIT, LEDGER, ACCOUNT, FUND_CODE, DEPTID, PROGRAM_CODE, PROJECT_ID, FISCAL_YEAR, ACCOUNTING_PERIOD, BUDGET_AMT, PRE_ENCUM_AMT, ENCUM_AMT, EXPEND_AMT. The master budget-checking table.
Budget type definitions: BUDGET_TYPE, DESCR. Controls budget-checking rules (hard check vs. soft check vs. track-only).
Budget journal entries: adjustments, transfers, amendments to the original budget. BUDGET_AMT change records.
Budget planning tables (if Planning & Budgeting module used): header/line for budget preparation process.
Requisition (source of pre-encumbrances): ChartField distribution on requisition lines creates pre-encumbrances in PS_LEDGER_KK.
Purchase order distribution (source of encumbrances): ChartField distribution on PO lines creates encumbrances when the PO is budget-checked.

attribute_mappings.transformation: Composite key identifying a budget line.

attribute_mappings.source: Derived from budget type and amounts

notes: PS Commitment Control (KK) is the budget-checking engine. Every transaction (journal, voucher, PO, requisition) is checked against PS_LEDGER_KK. Budget types control the severity: 'Hard' rejects over-budget, 'Soft' warns, 'Track' records only. Higher ed institutions heavily use pre-encumbrances (from requisitions) and encumbrances (from POs) to project available balances. The LEDGER field in PS_LEDGER_KK is typically 'CC_BUD' (commitment control budget). Budget amendments flow through PS_KK_BD_JOURNAL.
